sanskrit: janamejaya uvāca kathaṃ virāṭanagare mama pūrvapitāmahāḥ ajñātavāsam uṣitā duryodhanabhayārditāḥ
english: Janamejaya said: How did my great-grandfathers dwell unrecognised in the city of Virāṭa, tormented by fear of Duryodhana?

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tathā tu sa varāṃl labdhvā dharmād dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ gatvāśramaṃ brāhmaṇebhya ācakhyau sarvam eva tat
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Having thus received boons from Dharma, that best upholder of righteousness among righteous men went to the hermitage and recounted everything to the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit: kathayitvā tu tat sarvaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ araṇīsahitaṃ tasmai brāhmaṇāya nyavedayat
english: Having told all of that to the brāhmaṇas, Yudhiṣṭhira returned the fire-sticks together with the kindling-wood to that brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā dharmaputro mahāmanāḥ saṃnivartyānujān sarvān iti hovāca bhārata
english: Then King Yudhiṣṭhira, son of Dharma and great-souled one, having assembled all his younger brothers together, spoke thus, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: dvādaśemāni varṣāṇi rāṣṭrād viproṣitā vayam trayodaśo 'yaṃ saṃprāptaḥ kṛcchraḥ paramadurvasaḥ
english: These twelve years we have dwelt in exile from the kingdom; now the thirteenth has arrived, the most difficult and hard to endure.

sanskrit: sa sādhu kaunteya ito vāsam arjuna rocaya yatremā vasatīḥ sarvā vasemāviditāḥ paraiḥ
english: Therefore, O son of Kuntī, O Arjuna, please choose well a place of residence from here, where all of us may dwell entirely unrecognised by our enemies.

sanskrit: arjuna uvāca tasyaiva varadānena dharmasya manujādhipa ajñātā vicariṣyāmo narāṇāṃ bharatarṣabha
english: Arjuna said: By the very boon of Dharma himself, O lord of men, O bull of the Bharatas, we shall move about unrecognised among people.

sanskrit: kiṃ tu vāsāya rāṣṭrāṇi kīrtayiṣyāmi kāni cit ramaṇīyāni guptāni teṣāṃ kiṃ cit sma rocaya
english: Yet I shall name certain kingdoms that are pleasant and well-concealed as places to reside; please choose whichever one of them appeals to you.

sanskrit: santi ramyā janapadā bahvannāḥ paritaḥ kurūn pāñcālāś cedimatsyāś ca śūrasenāḥ paṭaccarāḥ daśārṇā navarāṣṭraṃ ca mallāḥ śālvā yugaṃdharāḥ
english: There are pleasant countries rich in food surrounding the Kurus: the Pāñcālas, the Cedis, the Matsyas, the Śūrasenas, the Paṭaccaras, the Daśārṇas, the Navarāṣṭra, the Mallas, the Śālvas, and the Yugaṃdharas.

sanskrit: eteṣāṃ katamo rājan nivāsas tava rocate vatsyāmo yatra rājendra saṃvatsaram imaṃ vayam
english: Which of these, O king, O lord of kings, does it please you to reside in? We shall dwell wherever you choose for this one year.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca evam etan mahābāho yathā sa bhagavān prabhuḥ abravīt sarvabhūteśas tat tathā na tad anyathā
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: It is exactly so, O mighty-armed one; as that blessed lord, the master of all beings, has spoken, so it shall be, and not otherwise.

sanskrit: avaśyaṃ tv eva vāsārthaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ śivaṃ sukham saṃmantrya sahitaiḥ sarvair draṣṭavyam akutobhayam
english: Yet for the purpose of our dwelling we must necessarily deliberate together, all of us, and find a place that is pleasant, auspicious, comfortable, and free from all danger.

sanskrit: matsyo virāṭo balavān abhirakṣet sa pāṇḍavān dharmaśīlo vadānyaś ca vṛddhaś ca sumahādhanaḥ
english: Virāṭa, king of the Matsyas, is powerful, and he would protect the Pāṇḍavas; he is virtuous in conduct, generous, advanced in age, and of very great wealth.

sanskrit: virāṭanagare tāta saṃvatsaram imaṃ vayam kurvantas tasya karmāṇi vihariṣyāma bhārata
english: In the city of Virāṭa, dear one, we shall spend this one year performing service for him, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: yāni yāni ca karmāṇi tasya śakṣyāmahe vayam kartuṃ yo yat sa tat karma bravītu kurunandanāḥ
english: And whatever tasks each of us is able to perform for him—let each one, O sons of Kuru's line, declare that task.

sanskrit: arjuna uvāca naradeva kathaṃ karma rāṣṭre tasya kariṣyasi virāṭanṛpateḥ sādho raṃsyase kena karmaṇā
english: Arjuna said: O king of men, O virtuous one, what work will you perform in the kingdom of King Virāṭa? In what occupation will you find pleasure?

sanskrit: mṛdur vadānyo hrīmāṃś ca dhārmikaḥ satyavikramaḥ rājaṃs tvam āpadā kliṣṭaḥ kiṃ kariṣyasi pāṇḍava
english: You are gentle, generous, modest, righteous, and one whose prowess is proven in truth—yet you are afflicted, O king, O Pāṇḍava; what will you do?

sanskrit: na duḥkham ucitaṃ kiṃ cid rājan veda yathā janaḥ sa imām āpadaṃ prāpya kathaṃ ghorāṃ tariṣyasi
english: You are not accustomed to any hardship in the manner that common people are; having encountered this terrible calamity, how will you endure it?

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca śṛṇudhvaṃ yat kariṣyāmi karma vai kurunandanāḥ virāṭam anusaṃprāpya rājānaṃ puruṣarṣabham
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: Listen, O sons of Kuru's line, to what work I shall indeed perform upon reaching Virāṭa, that bull among men and king.

sanskrit: sabhāstāro bhaviṣyāmi tasya rājño mahātmanaḥ kaṅko nāma dvijo bhūtvā matākṣaḥ priyadevitā
english: I shall become a dice-companion in the assembly of that great-souled king, presenting myself as a brāhmaṇa named Kaṅka, skilled at dice and fond of gambling.

sanskrit: vaiḍūryān kāñcanān dāntān phalair jyotīrasaiḥ saha kṛṣṇākṣāṃl lohitākṣāṃś ca nirvartsyāmi manoramān
english: I shall fashion beautiful dice of beryl, gold, and ivory, together with fruit-seeds and bright resins—black-spotted and red-spotted ones to delight the mind.

sanskrit: āsaṃ yudhiṣṭhirasyāhaṃ purā prāṇasamaḥ sakhā iti vakṣyāmi rājānaṃ yadi mām anuyokṣyate
english: 'I was formerly the dearest friend of Yudhiṣṭhira, equal to his very life'—so shall I tell the king, if he should question me.

sanskrit: ity etad vo mayākhyātaṃ vihariṣyāmy ahaṃ yathā vṛkodara virāṭe tvaṃ raṃsyase kena karmaṇā
english: Thus I have told you how I shall conduct myself. O Vṛkodara, in what occupation will you find pleasure in Virāṭa's kingdom?

sanskrit: bhīma uvāca paurogavo bruvāṇo 'haṃ ballavo nāma nāmataḥ upasthāsyāmi rājānaṃ virāṭam iti me matiḥ
english: Bhīma said: Presenting myself as a head cook named Ballava, I shall attend King Virāṭa—this is my intention.

sanskrit: sūpān asya kariṣyāmi kuśalo 'smi mahānase kṛtapūrvāṇi yair asya vyañjanāni suśikṣitaiḥ tān apy abhibhaviṣyāmi prītiṃ saṃjanayann aham
english: I shall prepare broths for him; I am skilled in the kitchen, and in the side-dishes those well-trained cooks have made before—I shall surpass even them, generating his delight.

sanskrit: āhariṣyāmi dārūṇāṃ nicayān mahato 'pi ca tat prekṣya vipulaṃ karma rājā prīto bhaviṣyati
english: I shall also bring in great stores of firewood, and seeing that prodigious labour the king will be pleased.

sanskrit: dvipā vā balino rājan vṛṣabhā vā mahābalāḥ vinigrāhyā yadi mayā nigrahīṣyāmi tān api
english: Should powerful elephants or mighty bulls need to be restrained, O king, I shall restrain those as well.

sanskrit: ye ca ke cin niyotsyanti samājeṣu niyodhakāḥ tān ahaṃ nihaniṣyāmi prītiṃ tasya vivardhayan
english: And whatever wrestlers may engage in bouts at festivals, I shall defeat them, increasing his delight.

sanskrit: na tv etān yudhyamānān vai haniṣyāmi kathaṃ cana tathaitān pātayiṣyāmi yathā yāsyanti na kṣayam
english: Yet I shall not slay those fighters in any manner whatsoever; I shall fell them in such a way that they suffer no mortal harm.

sanskrit: ārāliko govikartā sūpakartā niyodhakaḥ āsaṃ yudhiṣṭhirasyāham iti vakṣyāmi pṛcchataḥ
english: 'I was a pastry-cook, a meat-cutter, a broth-maker, and a wrestler for Yudhiṣṭhira'—so shall I say to those who question me.

sanskrit: ātmānam ātmanā rakṣaṃś cariṣyāmi viśāṃ pate ity etat pratijānāmi vihariṣyāmy ahaṃ yathā
english: Guarding myself by my own self, O lord of the people, I shall move about—this I pledge, and this is how I shall conduct myself.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca yam agnir brāhmaṇo bhūtvā samāgacchan nṛṇāṃ varam didhakṣuḥ khāṇḍavaṃ dāvaṃ dāśārhasahitaṃ purā
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: He whom the god Fire once approached in the form of a brāhmaṇa, desiring to burn the Khāṇḍava forest, seeking the best of men together with the son of Dāśārha—

sanskrit: mahābalaṃ mahābāhum ajitaṃ kurunandanam so 'yaṃ kiṃ karma kaunteyaḥ kariṣyati dhanaṃjayaḥ
english: That immensely strong, long-armed, unconquered son of Kuru's line—what task will that Dhanaṃjaya, son of Kuntī, now perform?

sanskrit: yo 'yam āsādya taṃ dāvaṃ tarpayām āsa pāvakam vijityaikarathenendraṃ hatvā pannagarākṣasān śreṣṭhaḥ pratiyudhāṃ nāma so 'rjunaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati
english: He who, having approached that forest, gratified the god of fire, having conquered Indra single-handedly with his chariot and slain serpents and rākṣasas—that Arjuna, foremost among warriors, what will he do?

sanskrit: sūryaḥ pratapatāṃ śreṣṭho dvipadāṃ brāhmaṇo varaḥ āśīviṣaś ca sarpāṇām agnis tejasvināṃ varaḥ
english: The sun is the foremost among those that blaze with heat; the brāhmaṇa is the best among two-footed beings; the venomous serpent is the best among snakes; and fire is the best among the radiant ones.

sanskrit: āyudhānāṃ varo varjaḥ kakudmī ca gavāṃ varaḥ hradānām udadhiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ parjanyo varṣatāṃ varaḥ
english: The thunderbolt is the best of weapons; the bull with a hump is the best of cattle; the ocean is the greatest among lakes and reservoirs; Parjanya is the best among those that rain.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭraś ca nāgānāṃ hastiṣv airāvato varaḥ putraḥ priyāṇām adhiko bhāryā ca suhṛdāṃ varā
english: Dhṛtarāṣṭra is the best among serpents; Airāvata is foremost among elephants; a son exceeds all that is dear; and a wife is the best among friends.

sanskrit: yathaitāni viśiṣṭāni jātyāṃ jātyāṃ vṛkodara evaṃ yuvā guḍākeśaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvadhanuṣmatām
english: Just as these are pre-eminent each in their own kind, O Vṛkodara, so too that young man Guḍākeśa is the foremost among all who wield the bow.

sanskrit: so 'yam indrād anavaro vāsudevāc ca bhārata gāṇḍīvadhanvā śvetāśvo bībhatsuḥ kiṃ kariṣyati
english: This Bībhatsu, wielder of the Gāṇḍīva bow, drawn by white horses, inferior to none save Indra and Vāsudeva—O Bhārata, what will he do?

sanskrit: uṣitvā pañca varṣāṇi sahasrākṣasya veśmani divyāny astrāṇy avāptāni devarūpeṇa bhāsvatā
english: Having dwelt for five years in the abode of the thousand-eyed Indra and having obtained divine weapons, gleaming with the form of a god—

sanskrit: yaṃ manye dvādaśaṃ rudram ādityānāṃ trayodaśam yasya bāhū samau dīrghau jyāghātakaṭhinatvacau dakṣiṇe caiva savye ca gavām iva vahaḥ kṛtaḥ
english: He whom I regard as the twelfth Rudra and the thirteenth Āditya, whose two arms are equal and long, the skin hardened by bowstring-slaps, and whose right and left arms bear the calluses of a cowherd's yoke—

sanskrit: himavān iva śailānāṃ samudraḥ saritām iva tridaśānāṃ yathā śakro vasūnām iva havyavāṭ
english: As the Himālayas among mountains, as the ocean among rivers, as Śakra among the thirty gods, as fire the bearer of oblations among the Vasus—

sanskrit: mṛgāṇām iva śārdūlo garuḍaḥ patatām iva varaḥ saṃnahyamānānām arjunaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati
english: As the tiger among deer, as Garuḍa foremost among birds in flight—so Arjuna, the best of those who arm themselves for battle—what will he do?

sanskrit: arjuna uvāca pratijñāṃ ṣaṇḍhako 'smīti kariṣyāmi mahīpate jyāghātau hi mahāntau me saṃvartuṃ nṛpa duṣkarau
english: Arjuna said: I shall make a declaration that I am a eunuch, O lord of the earth; for my two great bowstring-marks are difficult to conceal, O king.

sanskrit: karṇayoḥ pratimucyāhaṃ kuṇḍale jvalanopame veṇīkṛtaśirā rājan nāmnā caiva bṛhannaḍā
english: Adorning my ears with earrings blazing like fire, braiding my hair into a plait, O king, I shall go by the name of Bṛhannaḍā.

sanskrit: paṭhann ākhyāyikāṃ nāma strībhāvena punaḥ punaḥ ramayiṣye mahīpālam anyāṃś cāntaḥpure janān
english: Reciting the repertoire of stories, again and again adopting the nature of a woman, I shall delight the lord of the earth and the other people within the inner apartments.

sanskrit: gītaṃ nṛttaṃ vicitraṃ ca vāditraṃ vividhaṃ tathā śikṣayiṣyāmy ahaṃ rājan virāṭabhavane striyaḥ
english: Song, varied and wonderful dance, and diverse instrumental music—these I shall teach, O king, to the women in the palace of Virāṭa.

sanskrit: prajānāṃ samudācāraṃ bahu karmakṛtaṃ vadan chādayiṣyāmi kaunteya māyayātmānam ātmanā
english: Speaking of the conventions of common folk and of many accomplished deeds, O son of Kuntī, I shall conceal my true self from myself through this artifice.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhirasya gehe 'smi draupadyāḥ paricārikā uṣitāsmīti vakṣyāmi pṛṣṭo rājñā ca bhārata
english: 'I have lived in Yudhiṣṭhira's household as an attendant of Draupadī'—so shall I say when questioned by the king, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: etena vidhinā channaḥ kṛtakena yathā nalaḥ vihariṣyāmi rājendra virāṭabhavane sukham
english: By this means, disguised with an assumed identity as Nala was, I shall dwell happily in the palace of Virāṭa, O lord of kings.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kiṃ tvaṃ nakula kurvāṇas tatra tāta cariṣyasi sukumāraś ca śūraś ca darśanīyaḥ sukhocitaḥ
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: What will you do there, dear Nakula, going about? You are tender, brave, handsome to behold, and accustomed to comfort.

sanskrit: nakula uvāca aśvabandho bhaviṣyāmi virāṭanṛpater aham granthiko nāma nāmnāhaṃ karmaitat supriyaṃ mama
english: Nakula said: I shall become the horse-keeper of King Virāṭa; by name I shall be called Granthika—this work is very dear to me.

sanskrit: kuśalo 'smy aśvaśikṣāyāṃ tathaivāśvacikitsite priyāś ca satataṃ me 'śvāḥ kururāja yathā tava
english: I am skilled in horse-training and equally in the treatment of horses; horses are always dear to me, O king of Kurus, just as they are to you.

sanskrit: ye mām āmantrayiṣyanti virāṭanagare janāḥ tebhya evaṃ pravakṣyāmi vihariṣyāmy ahaṃ yathā
english: To those people in the city of Virāṭa who address me, I shall speak in the following manner, and thus I shall conduct myself.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca sahadeva kathaṃ tasya samīpe vihariṣyasi kiṃ vā tvaṃ tāta kurvāṇaḥ pracchanno vicariṣyasi
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: Sahadeva, how will you conduct yourself in his presence? And what will you do, dear one, moving about in disguise?

sanskrit: sahadeva uvāca gosaṃkhyātā bhaviṣyāmi virāṭasya mahīpateḥ pratiṣeddhā ca dogdhā ca saṃkhyāne kuśalo gavām
english: Sahadeva said: I shall become the cattle-enumerator of Virāṭa, lord of the earth; a herd-protector and a milker as well, skilled in the counting of cattle.

sanskrit: tantipāla iti khyāto nāmnā viditam astu te nipuṇaṃ ca cariṣyāmi vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ
english: Known by the name Tantipāla—let this be known to you; I shall move about with skill. Let the fever of your mind depart.

sanskrit: ahaṃ hi bhavatā goṣu satataṃ prakṛtaḥ purā tatra me kauśalaṃ karma avabuddhaṃ viśāṃ pate
english: For I was constantly engaged by you in the care of cattle in former times; there my skilled work was learned and understood, O lord of the people.

sanskrit: lakṣaṇaṃ caritaṃ cāpi gavāṃ yac cāpi maṅgalam tat sarvaṃ me suviditam anyac cāpi mahīpate
english: The marks, the behaviour, and whatever is auspicious about cattle—all of that is well known to me, and much else besides, O lord of the earth.

sanskrit: vṛṣabhān api jānāmi rājan pūjitalakṣaṇān yeṣāṃ mūtram upāghrāya api vandhyā prasūyate
english: I also know bulls of distinguished marks, O king, whose urine, when smelled, causes even a barren cow to conceive.

sanskrit: so 'ham evaṃ cariṣyāmi prītir atra hi me sadā na ca māṃ vetsyati paras tat te rocatu pārthiva
english: I shall conduct myself in this way, for my delight always lies here, and no enemy shall recognise me. May this please you, O lord of the earth.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca iyaṃ tu naḥ priyā bhāryā prāṇebhyo 'pi garīyasī māteva paripālyā ca pūjyā jyeṣṭheva ca svasā
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: But this dear wife of ours, more precious to us than our very lives—she must be protected like a mother and honoured like an elder sister.

sanskrit: kena sma karmaṇā kṛṣṇā draupadī vicariṣyati na hi kiṃ cid vijānāti karma kartuṃ yathā striyaḥ
english: By what work will Kṛṣṇā Draupadī move about? For she does not know any task in the way that ordinary women do.

sanskrit: sukumārī ca bālā ca rājaputrī yaśasvinī pativratā mahābhāgā kathaṃ nu vicariṣyati
english: She is delicate, still young, a princess of great renown, devoted to her husband, supremely blessed—how indeed will she go about?

sanskrit: mālyagandhān alaṃkārān vastrāṃi vividhāni ca etāny evābhijānāti yato jātā hi bhāminī
english: Garlands, perfumes, ornaments, and various garments—these alone she is acquainted with, for from birth she has been a highborn lady.

sanskrit: draupady uvāca sairandhryo 'rakṣitā loke bhujiṣyāḥ santi bhārata naivam anyāḥ striyo yānti iti lokasya niścayaḥ
english: Draupadī said: There exist in the world, O Bhārata, independent female attendants who are unprotected—it is the settled conviction of people that no other women go about in that way.

sanskrit: sāhaṃ bruvāṇā sairandhrī kuśalā keśakarmaṇi ātmaguptā cariṣyāmi yan māṃ tvam anupṛcchasi
english: Presenting myself as a sairandhrī skilled in hairdressing, I shall move about protecting myself—since you ask me about it.

sanskrit: sudeṣṇāṃ pratyupasthāsye rājabhāryāṃ yaśasvinīm sā rakṣiṣyati māṃ prāptāṃ mā te bhūd duḥkham īdṛśam
english: I shall present myself in service to Sudeṣṇā, the illustrious royal wife; she will protect me when I have arrived—let not such sorrow be yours.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca kalyāṇaṃ bhāṣase kṛṣṇe kule jātā yathā vadet na pāpam abhijānāsi sādhu sādhvīvrate sthitā
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: You speak auspiciously, O Kṛṣṇā, as one born of a noble lineage would speak. You know no sin; well done, you who stand firm in the vow of a virtuous wife.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca karmāṇy uktāni yuṣmābhir yāni tāni kariṣyatha mama cāpi yathābuddhi rucitāni viniścayāt
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: The tasks you have each declared, those you shall carry out; and mine also, agreeable as they are to my intellect, are firmly determined.

sanskrit: purohito 'yam asmākam agnihotrāṇi rakṣatu sūdapaurogavaiḥ sārdhaṃ drupadasya niveśane
english: Let this our family priest guard the sacred fires, together with the cooks and provisioners, in the abode of Drupada.

sanskrit: indrasenamukhāś ceme rathān ādāya kevalān yāntu dvāravatīṃ śīghram iti me vartate matiḥ
english: And let these men, headed by Indrasena, taking only the chariots, proceed quickly to Dvāravatī—this is the thinking that prevails in my mind.

sanskrit: imāś ca nāryo draupadyāḥ sarvaśaḥ paricārikāḥ pāñcālān eva gacchantu sūdapaurogavaiḥ saha
english: And all these women who are attendants of Draupadī—let them go to the Pāñcālas, together with the cooks and provisioners.

sanskrit: sarvair api ca vaktavyaṃ na prajñāyanta pāṇḍavāḥ gatā hy asmān apākīrya sarve dvaitavanād iti
english: And all should say: 'The Pāṇḍavas are nowhere to be found; indeed they all departed from the Dvaita forest after abandoning us.'

sanskrit: dhaumya uvāca vidite cāpi vaktavyaṃ suhṛdbhir anurāgataḥ ato 'ham api vakṣyāmi hetumātraṃ nibodhata
english: Dhaumya said: Even to those who know the truth, dear friends should speak with affection; therefore I too shall speak just the reason for it—hear me.

sanskrit: hantemāṃ rājavasatiṃ rājaputrā bravīmi vaḥ yathā rājakulaṃ prāpya caran preṣyo na riṣyati
english: Come, O princes, I shall tell you how one who moves about in a royal household in service shall not come to harm.

sanskrit: durvasaṃ tv eva kauravyā jānatā rājaveśmani amānitaiḥ sumānārhā ajñātaiḥ parivatsaram
english: Truly, O scions of Kuru, those who know the hardship of royal dwellings, who deserve great honour yet go unhonoured, who are unrecognised—they must endure it for the full year.

sanskrit: diṣṭadvāro labhed dvāraṃ na ca rājasu viśvaset tad evāsanam anvicched yatra nābhiṣajet paraḥ
english: One should obtain access through the appointed gate and should not trust in kings; one should seek out only that seat where no enemy will assail him.

sanskrit: nāsya yānaṃ na paryaṅkaṃ na pīṭhaṃ na gajaṃ ratham ārohet saṃmato 'smīti sa rājavasatiṃ vaset
english: He should not mount the king's conveyance, nor his couch, nor his seat, nor his elephant, nor his chariot, thinking 'I am esteemed'—thus he may dwell in a royal household.

sanskrit: atha yatrainam āsīnaṃ śaṅkeran duṣṭacāriṇaḥ na tatropaviśej jātu sa rājavasatiṃ vaset
english: And wherever those of corrupt conduct might suspect him when he is seated, he should never sit there—thus he may dwell in a royal household.
